skill.name: amazon-review-aggregates-and-extended-history-scraper
skill.description: Collect public Amazon reviews and rating summaries through an Apify Actor using product URLs, ASINs, keywords, or category URLs. Configure marketplace merging, public extended history, review filters, and JSON output.
skill.summary: Run configurable Amazon review collection and rating aggregation through Apify.
skill.author: bolvein-firex

security_audit.summary: All 84 static findings are false positives involving documentation syntax, expected API authentication, or intentional input-file reads. One semantic finding identifies a privacy toggle that incorrectly implies GDPR compliance. No evidence found of prompt injection or malicious exfiltration; the remote Actor implementation was not available for inspection.

remediation.issue: The includeGdprSensitive description incorrectly presents disabling selected identity fields as sufficient for GDPR compliance.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the compliance guarantee and describe only the omitted fields. Document remaining personal-data risks, lawful processing, retention, and third-party handling.

semantic_findings.title: Privacy Toggle Overstates GDPR Compliance
semantic_findings.description: The includeGdprSensitive description states: "Set to false for GDPR compliance." Disabling names, profile links, and avatars cannot establish compliance alone. Review text, locations, and enabled media can still contain personal data, creating a misleading assurance for downstream processing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The schema explicitly makes the compliance claim while enabling review media by default. The declared output also retains review text and locations.

content.user_title: Collect Amazon Reviews and Rating Summaries
content.value_statement: Amazon reviews and rating summaries are spread across products and regional marketplaces. This skill configures an Apify Actor to collect public review data with filters, marketplace merging, and JSON output.
actual_capabilities: Accept product URLs or bare ASINs, or configure discovery through keywords and Amazon category URLs.
Configure 19 Amazon marketplaces and merge additional marketplace reviews with documented deduplication.
Enable the documented public Amazon.com extended review feed and optional product rating aggregate records.
Configure star, verification, keyword, date, and media filters, plus helpfulness or recency sorting.
Submit JSON input through the Node runner and print the synchronous Apify response as formatted JSON.
Provide curl examples for asynchronous runs, status checks, and dataset retrieval.
limitations: Execution requires an Apify account and APIFY_TOKEN; Actor usage is billed, and the bundled Node runner requires Node 18 or later.
Review coverage varies by ASIN; the documented extended feed covers Amazon.com and does not guarantee complete review history.
The remote Actor implementation is not bundled, and its live behavior was not verified during this review.
The runner prints JSON, not CSV; disabling identity fields does not guarantee privacy compliance or remove personal details from review text.

use_cases.title: Investigate Product Complaints
use_cases.description: Collect recent critical reviews for selected ASINs and inspect recurring product issues using review text and verification flags.

use_cases.title: Compare Regional Feedback
use_cases.description: Merge available reviews across selected marketplaces and compare feedback using the declared sourceMarketplace and rating fields.

use_cases.title: Prepare Repeatable Review Exports
use_cases.description: Use the supplied runner or asynchronous API examples to retrieve filtered review datasets for an existing analysis workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a Small Review Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a run for ASIN [ASIN] on amazon.com with maxReviews set to 30 and includeAggregates enabled. Confirm estimated charges before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Recent Verified Complaints
prompt_templates.prompt: Configure [PRODUCT_URL] for recent critical reviews from verified purchases since [DATE], capped at 100. Explain date-parsing limitations before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Discover Products and Merge Markets
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare discovery for [KEYWORD], limited to five products. Merge amazon.co.uk and amazon.de, enable aggregates, and keep identity fields disabled. Request approval before running.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine discovery and regional coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Asynchronous Dataset Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous Apify run for [PRODUCT_URLS] with public extended history and a 500-review cap per product. Confirm costs, poll completion, then retrieve JSON.
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert: retrieve a larger dataset after completion.

output_examples.input: Collect up to 30 reviews and rating aggregates for one Amazon.com product.
output: Illustrative output only; no live collection was performed.
Review rows contain product ASIN, star rating, title, review text, verification status, and date.
An available aggregate record adds average rating, global ratings count, and the star distribution.

output_examples.input: Merge reviews for one ASIN from Amazon.com and Amazon.de, keeping recent critical reviews.
output: Illustrative output only; returned coverage depends on the product and marketplace.
Matching review rows retain their review identifiers and source marketplace for regional comparison.
Narrow filters can return few or no matching reviews.

best_practices: Start with one product and a small review cap; inspect returned rows and confirm current Actor pricing before scaling.
Keep APIFY_TOKEN in the environment and submit only public product inputs, never cookies, sessions, or private account information.
Minimize collected personal data and review applicable terms, lawful processing, access controls, and retention requirements before sharing datasets.
anti_patterns: Treating public extended history as a complete archive or a representative sample of every marketplace.
Launching large paid runs without reviewing product counts, review caps, and current Actor pricing.
Assuming disabled reviewer identity fields make review text, media, or downstream processing automatically privacy compliant.

faq.question: What credentials and runtime are required?
faq.answer: Set APIFY_TOKEN for an Apify account. The bundled runner requires Node 18 or later; the documentation also provides curl examples.

faq.question: Does collection incur charges?
faq.answer: Yes. Apify bills Actor usage to your account. Check the Actor Pricing tab before running or increasing limits.

faq.question: Does extended history return every review?
faq.answer: No. Coverage varies by ASIN, and the documented extended feed contains Amazon.com reviews. Filters and review caps can reduce results further.

faq.question: Which marketplaces can I configure?
faq.answer: The input schema lists 19 Amazon domains, including the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and India. Additional marketplace reviews can be merged.

faq.question: Can I supply login cookies or private data?
faq.answer: No. The documented guardrails allow public data only and prohibit cookies, sessions, and private account information. Disabling identity fields does not establish GDPR compliance.

faq.question: Can the bundled runner export CSV?
faq.answer: No. It prints formatted JSON. Convert the returned dataset with a separate tool when CSV is required.
